2026–27 FC St. Pauli season }} '''Fußball-Club St. Pauli von 1910 e.V.''', commonly known as simply '''St. Pauli''' ({{IPA|de|ɛfˌtseː zaŋkt ˈpaʊli|-|De-FC St. Pauli.ogg}}), is a German professional [[association football|football]] club based in the [[St. Pauli]] district of [[Hamburg]]. The team will play in the [[2. Bundesliga]] for the [[2026–27 2. Bundesliga|2026–27 season]] following relegation from the [[Bundesliga]] in [[2025–26 Bundesliga|2025–26]]. The [[Association football|football]] department is part of a larger sports club that also has departments in [[rugby football|rugby]] ([[FC St. Pauli Rugby]]), [[baseball]], [[bowling]], [[boxing]] (FC St. Pauli Boxen),{{cite web|url=http://www.st-pauli-boxen.de/bc-barracuda.htm|title=Die Boxabteilung des FC St. Pauli|publisher=st-pauli-boxen.de|access-date=21 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150806215308/http://www.st-pauli-boxen.de/bc-barracuda.htm|archive-date=6 August 2015|url-status=dead}} [[chess]], [[cycle sport|cycling]], [[handball]], [[roller derby]] ([[Harbor Girls Hamburg]]),{{cite web|url=http://harborgirls.de/about/|title=About|publisher=harbourgirls.de|access-date=21 July 2015|archive-date=23 May 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150523061638/http://harborgirls.de/about/|url-status=live}} [[skittles (sport)|skittles]], [[softball]], [[table tennis]], and since 2011, [[marathon]].Fabian Balicki: Więcej niż piłka nożna? St. Pauli jest tą możliwością. Poligraf, 2015, {{ISBN|978-83-7856-321-1}}. Until the end of 2013, the club also had a department in [[American football]], but it was dissolved because it lacked the youth team required in order to hold a men's team.{{cite web |url=http://www.fcstpauli.com/data/news/verein/home_page/jhv_2013/nsb_jhv |title=Harmonische Mitgliederversammlung |website=fcstpauli.com |publisher=FC St. Pauli |date=27 November 2013 |access-date=4 May 2010 |archive-date=3 December 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131203022718/http://www.fcstpauli.com/data/news/verein/home_page/jhv_2013/nsb_jhv |url-status=live }} As of April 2023, FC St. Pauli has 30,400 members.{{cite web |url=https://www.kicker.de/fc-st-pauli/info/2-bundesliga/2015-16 |title=FC St. Pauli |website=[[Kicker (magazine)|Kicker]] |publisher=Olympia-Verlag GmbH |access-date=5 April 2023 |archive-date=4 May 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190504185550/https://www.kicker.de/news/fussball/2bundesliga/vereine/2-bundesliga/2015-16/fc-st-pauli-18/vereinsinformationen.html |url-status=live }} The men's professional football team dropped down to the [[Regionalliga (football)|Regionalliga]] in 2003, at that time the third highest football division in Germany and remained there for four years. In 2007, they won promotion back to the [[2. Bundesliga]], the German second tier. In 2010, they won promotion back to the top-flight Bundesliga, but were immediately relegated the following season. Their current tenure in the top-flight dates to their promotion in [[2023-24 2. Bundesliga|2023–24 season]]. FC St. Pauli has an intra-city rivalry with [[Hamburger SV]], with whom they contest the ''[[Hamburg derby]]'', the only cross-city derby currently featured in the Bundesliga. The club also has a more recent rivalry with [[F.C. Hansa Rostock|Hansa Rostock]], known as the ''[[Politisches derby|Political derby]]'', or even the ''Fear derby'', reflecting the divergent political identities of the two clubs.{{cite news |author= |date=8 March 2012 |title=Für die Fans: St. Pauli klagt für Hansa Rostock|url=http://www.mopo.de/st-pauli/untersagungsverfuegung-fuer-die-fans--st--pauli-klagt-fuer-hansa-rostock,5067040,11805190.html |language=de |newspaper=Hamburger Morgenpost |location=Hamburg |publisher=Morgenpost Verlag GmbH |access-date=31 July 2015 }}{{cite web |url=http://www.11freunde.de/interview/hansa-rostock-gegen-st-pauli-das-gefaehrlichste-spiel-des-jahres |title=Hansa Rostock gegen St. Pauli: Das gefährlichste Spiel des Jahres |last=Peter |first=Erik |date=18 November 2011 |website=11freunde.de |publisher=11FREUNDE Verlag GmbH & Co. KG |language=de |access-date=31 July 2015 |archive-date=22 December 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222154758/http://www.11freunde.de/interview/hansa-rostock-gegen-st-pauli-das-gefaehrlichste-spiel-des-jahres |url-status=live }} Although the club has been only modestly successful, it is widely recognised for its distinctive social culture and has a large popular following as one of the country's "Kult" clubs.{{cite web |url=http://www.midfielddynamo.com/clubs/profiles/stpauli/st-pauli.htm |title=Midfield Dynamo Football Site |publisher=Midfielddynamo.com |access-date=4 May 2010 |archive-date=17 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220117154821/http://www.midfielddynamo.com/clubs/profiles/stpauli/st-pauli.htm |url-status=live }}{{cite web |url=http://www.fcstpauli.com/staticsite/staticsite.php?menuid=496&topmenu=113&keepmenu=inactive&keepmenu=inactive |title=Offizielle Homepage des FC St. Pauli von 1910 e. V. – Mannschaft |publisher=FC St. Pauli |access-date=4 May 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100505193614/http://www.fcstpauli.com/staticsite/staticsite.php?menuid=496&topmenu=113&keepmenu=inactive&keepmenu=inactive |archive-date=5 May 2010}} FC St. Pauli and supporters are strongly identified with their support of [[left-wing politics]].{{cite web |last1=Conti |first1=Allie |title=It's an Anti-Fascist Thing: How an Obscure German Soccer Team Gained a Brooklyn Cult |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/07/nyregion/fc-st-pauli-east-river-bar.html |website=The New York Times |date=7 February 2019 |access-date=1 October 2022 |archive-date=9 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221109064951/https://www.nytimes.com/2019/02/07/nyregion/fc-st-pauli-east-river-bar.html |url-status=live }}"}}
